page_title: PSG 1-0 LEN | PSG v Lens 02/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
90+1' PSG have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
86' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kevin Danso (Lens) was quite harsh and Willy Delajod didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' The attendance is 47926.
82' Deiver Machado (Lens) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
80' Substitution. Andy Diouf makes way for David Pereira da Costa (Lens).
80' Substitution. Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) in, Anass Zaroury out.
76' The resulting set piece from PSG is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

76' Desire Doue (PSG) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Desire Doue (PSG) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.
72' PSG take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

72' Bradley Barcola (PSG) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Brice Samba stops the ball from going inside the top right corner. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
71' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Marco Asensio is replaced by Desire Doue (PSG).
71' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Fabian Ruiz as he is replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).
69' The ball falls kindly for Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) inside the box, but it's a poor effort and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
68' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Lens have been awarded a corner kick. Andy Diouf (Lens) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Andy Diouf (Lens) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
63' Will Still has decided to make a change. Malang Sarr (Lens) replaces Jonathan Gradit.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adrien Thomasson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
62' Andy Diouf (Lens) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
61' That will be all from Ousmane Dembele who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Kang-In Lee (PSG).
59' RED card! Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) can’t believe it as the referee orders him from the pitch following the VAR review.

58' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens), but referee Willy Delajod must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
57' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
57' Marquinhos (PSG) receives a yellow card for infringement.
53' Kevin Danso (Lens) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
53' Lens will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Andy Diouf (Lens) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
50' Marco Asensio (PSG) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Brice Samba comes off his line to intercept.

48' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
47' Jonathan Gradit (Lens) is penalised.
46' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and it's Andy Diouf (Lens) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' Willy Delajod has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Will Still (Lens) gets a yellow card, off the field.

45+4' Bradley Barcola (PSG) finds himself in a promising position to finish! He unleashes a poor shot which flies into the stands. What a poor effort that was! The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
45+3' Bradley Barcola (PSG) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
45+1' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Willy Delajod had an easy-decision to make.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
43' Marco Asensio (PSG) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Brice Samba is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
42' Marco Asensio (PSG) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
40' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
36' Lens failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
36' Now Lens have a corner. Deiver Machado (Lens) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
35' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
33' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ousmane Dembele (PSG). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
32' Deiver Machado (Lens) finds the space inside the box to meet a cross, but his effort from near the penalty spot towards the right post is saved by the goalkeeper.
28' Willy Delajod blows the whistle, Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) is penalised for a foul.
26' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
23' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
21' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
20' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Hamzat Ojediran.
19' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
18' Florian Sotoca (Lens) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' Florian Sotoca (Lens) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

15' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) displays a great technique and excellent ball control. He weaves his way through the defence to the goal and fires the ball from inside the box, but it goes painfully wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lens.
14' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

14' Marco Asensio (PSG) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out of play and PSG have been awarded a corner kick.

13' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
11' The corner from Anass Zaroury (Lens) is cleared away by the defence.
8' Vitinha (PSG) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
6' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Deiver Machado (Lens) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

4' 1 - 0 Goal! Bradley Barcola displays great vision and sends a pass to Ousmane Dembele (PSG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
2' Bradley Barcola (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lens will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and PSG will have the kick-off.
